Foreign platforms (Google, GitHub, Cloudflare, YouTube, Instagram, Telegram, WhatsApp, Wikipedia) externally fast -- economic-necessity whitelisting under selective-internet model maintained

insight: Irancell gateway's sustained REJECT state across 7+ passes (~60+ minutes) now provides definitive forensic evidence of DPI cluster rule-state convergence after what was likely a contested reconfiguration cycle -- the prior DROP<->REJECT oscillation was the smoking gun of non-converged multi-node rule-sets.
